description: Second wave of enhanced world generation roles with high-competency cross-references to master worldbuilders and simulation designers.

roles.name: Procedural Content Coherence Ultra Specialist

coder_style_references.style: Deep systems thinking where generation rules produce consistent, believable results.

coder_style_references.style: Worlds that feel alive and intentional because systems interact honestly.
coder_style_references.application: Prioritize systemic coherence over individual beautiful but disconnected pieces.

coder_style_references.style: Grounded generation that respects real constraints and produces usable results.
coder_style_references.application: Procedural content must be practical and playable, not just visually impressive.

roles.validation_notes: Cross-referenced with advanced procedural generation and world coherence practices.
